# Holbrook & Manter

> > A comprehensive accounting, tax, and financial advisory firm serving businesses and individuals across Ohio with specialized expertise in auditing, CFO services, wealth management, and industry-specific solutions.

Holbrook & Manter is a full-service CPA and advisory firm based in Columbus, Ohio with additional offices in Akron and Canton. The firm provides accounting, tax, audit, business valuation, wealth management, and specialized consulting services to small and mid-sized businesses, families, and high-net-worth individuals.

## Key Topics

- Accounting Services
- Tax Planning & Preparation
- Business Advisory
- CFO Services
- Business Valuation
- Wealth Management
- Estate Planning
- SOX Compliance
- SOC Audit
- Succession Planning
- ESOP Trustee Services
- Risk Advisory
- Family Businesses
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- Financial Planning

## Core Services

- [Services](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services): Comprehensive catalog of accounting, tax, and financial planning services
- [Audit & Accounting](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/audit-accounting): Business auditing, accounting, and valuation services in Columbus, Ohio
- [Tax Services](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/tax): Tax planning, preparation, and IRS representation for individuals and businesses
- [Business Advisory Services](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/business-advisory-services): Comprehensive business advisory, tax, and CFO consulting services
- [Business Services Solutions](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/business-services-solutions): Business coaching, financial planning, and advisory solutions for growth
- [Business Valuation](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/business-valuation): Expert CPA business valuation for M&A, succession, and estate planning

## Wealth & Estate Planning

- [Private Wealth Management](https://privatewealth.holbrookmanter.com): Private wealth management and estate planning for high-net-worth individuals
- [Trust & Estate Planning](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/trust-estate-planning): Trust, estate planning, and fiduciary services for wealth transfer and legacy
- [Family & Closely-Held Businesses](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/family-closely-held-businesses): Family business accounting, succession planning, and wealth transfer services

## Compliance & Risk Management

- [Risk Advisory Services](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/risk-advisory): Risk advisory, SOX compliance, and internal controls consulting
- [SOX Compliance](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/risk-advisory/sox-compliance): Sarbanes-Oxley compliance and Section 404 audit services
- [SOC Audit & Reporting](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/risk-advisory/soc-audit-services): SOC 1 and SOC 2 audit and reporting services for service organizations
- [ESOP Trustee Services](https://www.holbrookmanter.com/services/esop): ESOP trustee services including transaction oversight and governance support
